newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-NIKE TO INTERVENE IN RONALDO-BARCELONA TALKS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NIKE TO INTERVENE IN RONALDO-BARCELONA TALKS.

text.p: American sportswear firm Nike may act as intermediary in a bid to keep Brazilian striker Ronaldo at Barcelona.
"Nike is going to try to stop Ronaldo leaving Barcelona and to this end we are going to act as mediators between the club and his representatives," Nike spokeswoman Laura Alsina said.
Alsina said Nike would shortly be speaking to Ronaldo's agents, who pulled out of negotiations to renew the striker's contract last Tuesday.
Inter Milan, the Italian club thought most likely to sign Ronaldo, are sponsored by British company Umbro.
Barcelona president Jose Luis Nunez said that Nike managers would travel to France to talk to Ronaldo, who is with the Brazilian national side.
Nunez also recognised that Nike had made an offer to make the team kit, a deal that could be worth 18 billion pesetas ($124 million) over 10 years.
Other manufacturers are believed to have made similar offers.
